item_short_desc: Embark on wilderness excursions and outdoor adventures worry-free with Rothco’s Portable Camp Toilet. Crafted with a heavy-duty steel support frame and durable plastic molded seat, the portable toilet guarantees stability and comfort. With a weight capacity of 260 pounds and 6 plastic commode bags included, this foldable camping toilet ensures convenience during extended outdoor stays. This portable toliet is a must-have for outdoor enthusiasts, overlanders, and campers alike.
description: Embark on wilderness excursions and outdoor adventures worry-free with Rothco’s Portable Camp Toilet. Crafted with a heavy-duty steel support frame and durable plastic molded seat, the portable toilet guarantees stability and comfort. With a weight capacity of 260 pounds and 6 plastic commode bags included, this foldable camping toilet ensures convenience during extended outdoor stays. The foldable toilet’s compact design, approximately 11 inches X 12 1/2 inches X 16 inches when fully assembled, accommodates a 2-gallon bucket underneath, making it a must-have for outdoor enthusiasts, overlanders, and campers alike.
